messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Quick win alert  AegisVault (insurtech claims) just went live via the Azure ISV listing and signed a 12-month reserved capacity trial :tada:
Diego (Sales): Huge — they committed after the demo last week. Legal cleared the logo and quote.
Pri (Solutions Eng): Migrated their model bundle and enabled the short-seq kernel. p50 generation ~110ms. Small tokenizer mapping tweak fixed occasional truncated policy numbers.
Ruth (Customer Success): Customer reported the SDK integration took <2 hours using our sample repo. They asked for a short ops playbook for their SREs. I'll draft it.
Pri (Solutions Eng): For reproducibility, sample cmd I used during validation:
```
# smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compact-v1","input":"Validate claim #12345"}'
```
Deploy Bot: deploy/redwood-compact-v1 -> aegisvault-prod succeeded (job d-112358) ✅
Pri (Solutions Eng): Also added a canary: 8% traffic -> quantized variant with auto-fallback at 0.5% error rate.
Nina (Partnerships): Pilot outcomes: ~2.1x cost vs their prior infra, median latency ~105ms, and plan to roll to two more product lines. They've agreed to a short customer story.
Diego (Sales): I'll coordinate with marketing for the case study and get the signed quote into the partner drive.
Ruth (Customer Success): I'll schedule a 30-min ops walk-through with their SREs next Tuesday. Calendar invite incoming.
Nina (Partnerships): Massive thanks everyone 389. Please drop any 2-line blurbs to #all-hands and I'll compile for the company update. @here :tada:
